title: Marketing & Operations Executive
description:
Marketing Operations Executive

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in any discipline

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Marketing Operations Executive** to support our Marketing team with day\-to\-day coordination, campaign execution, data management, reporting, follow\-ups, and administrative activities.

The ideal candidate should be **organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets, digital tools, trackers, and multiple teams**. Good communication and strong follow\-up skills are important for this role.

Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Operations \& Coordination

* Support the Marketing team in executing day\-to\-day marketing activities and campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure marketing tasks are completed on time.
* Maintain marketing calendars, task trackers, campaign records, and activity reports.
* Follow up with team members on pending activities, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Track the status of ongoing marketing activities and highlight delays or pending actions.
* Assist in coordinating promotional activities, events, campaigns, and other marketing initiatives.

Content \& Digital Marketing Support

* Coordinate with the content and design teams for marketing requirements.
* Collect and organize product information, images, creatives, and other marketing materials.
* Support social media and digital marketing activities as required.
* Coordinate with external agencies, freelancers, vendors, and service providers when required.
* Maintain organized records of marketing content, campaigns, and related documents.

Data, Reporting \& Documentation

* Maintain marketing data, reports, trackers, and spreadsheets.
* Update campaign and activity records regularly.
* Assist in preparing basic reports and summaries for the Marketing team.
* Ensure marketing\-related documents and information are properly maintained.
* Work with Excel/Google Sheets for data entry, tracking, reporting, and coordination.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* **1–3 years of experience** in Marketing Operations, Marketing Coordination, Sales Coordination, Administration, or a related role is preferred.
* Good communication skills in **English and Tamil**.
* Hindi will be an added advantage.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel and Google Sheets**.
* Comfortable working with data, reports, trackers, and digital tools.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and coordinate with different teams.
* Proactive approach with attention to detail.

Key Skills

* Marketing Operations
* Marketing Coordination
* Team Coordination
* MS Excel
* Google Sheets
* Campaign Coordination
* Data Management
* Reporting \& Documentation
* Follow\-up \& Communication
* Digital Marketing Support
* Vendor Coordination
* Time Management
* Problem Solving

Who Can Apply?

Candidates with experience in **Marketing Coordination, Marketing Operations, Sales Coordination, Business Operations, Administration, or similar roles** are encouraged to apply.

Graduates with strong communication, Excel/Google Sheets skills, and an interest in marketing operations may also be considered.

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Marketing Operations: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development & Marketing Executive
description:
**Business Development \& Marketing Executive**

Inbound / Digital \| Full\-Time \| Work from Office

**Hiring for: RK Creators**  
**Location:** Gandhipuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Work Mode:** Full\-Time \| Work from Office  
**Salary:** ₹10,000 – ₹20,000/month \+ Performance\-Based Incentives  
**Experience:** Freshers / 0–1 Year

**Important: Please Read Before Applying**

This is **NOT a field\-sales role**.

✔ No field sales  
✔ No door\-to\-door sales  
✔ No cold calling  
✔ No random lead generation through personal contacts  
✔ Primarily **inbound leads, digital channels, client communication and business coordination**

***About RK Creators***

**RK Creators** is looking for an enthusiastic and career\-oriented **Business Development \& Marketing Executive** to support our growing business through **inbound lead management, digital marketing, client communication and business coordination**.

This opportunity is particularly suitable for candidates who want to develop practical skills across **digital marketing, business development, client handling and professional communication**.

You will receive structured guidance and hands\-on exposure rather than being expected to immediately perform as an experienced sales professional.

***What You'll Do***

As part of the business development and marketing team, your responsibilities will include:

* Responding to and managing **inbound enquiries and leads**
* Communicating with prospective clients through phone, WhatsApp, email and other professional channels
* Understanding client requirements and coordinating with the relevant internal team
* Following up with interested prospects and maintaining lead status
* Supporting **digital marketing activities**, including social media and email campaigns
* Assisting with preparation and sharing of proposals, quotations and other client documents
* Maintaining accurate client and lead records
* Coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth client onboarding and service delivery
* Supporting marketing initiatives and other business\-growth activities
* Learning and applying professional approaches to **lead management, client communication and business development**

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for candidates who are:

* Confident and professional in communication
* Comfortable speaking with clients and understanding their requirements
* Interested in **digital marketing, business development and client management**
* Willing to learn new tools, platforms and business processes
* Organized and capable of following up on multiple leads/tasks
* Positive, responsible and target\-oriented
* Comfortable working as part of an office\-based team

**Freshers Are Welcome**

You **do not need prior sales experience** to apply.

If you are a fresher with good communication skills, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in marketing or business development, we encourage you to apply.

Candidates with **0–1 year of experience** in business development, digital marketing, customer support, inside sales or client coordination may also apply.

Eligibility

**Education:** Any UG / PG Degree

**Experience:** Freshers or 0–1 year

**Preferred Skills:**

* Good verbal and written communication
* Basic knowledge of social media and digital platforms
* Basic MS Office / Google Workspace skills
* Good follow\-up and coordination ability
* Professional attitude and willingness to learn

**Added advantage:** Candidates with exposure to digital marketing, social media management, CRM tools, lead management or client communication.

**Why Join RK Creators?**

\-Structured Learning

Get practical training and guidance during the initial trainee phase.

\-Digital \& Business Exposure

Work with real client enquiries and gain hands\-on exposure to **digital marketing, business development and service\-based business operations**.

\-No Traditional Sales Pressure

The role does not involve field sales, door\-to\-door sales or cold\-calling campaigns.

\-Clear Career Growth

**Trainee → Business Development Executive → Senior Executive**

Your growth will be based on **performance, learning, communication skills and ability to handle responsibilities independently**.

\-Professional Work Environment

Work from our office in **Gandhipuram, Coimbatore**, alongside a team where you can learn through practical experience and day\-to\-day collaboration.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

This role would be a good fit if you are someone who:

**✔ Likes communicating with people**  
**✔ Wants to learn marketing and business development**  
**✔ Can take ownership of follow\-ups and tasks**  
**✔ Is comfortable using digital tools**  
**✔ Wants a long\-term office\-based career rather than field sales**  
**✔ Is willing to learn and grow with the organization**

Selection Process

**Step 1:** Telephonic / Initial Screening  
**Step 2:** Face\-to\-Face Interview

Direct walk\-in are also allowed

Candidates should be comfortable attending the **in\-person interview at our Gandhipuram, Coimbatore office**.

How to Apply

Apply directly through this job portal **or send your updated resume to:**

**softscholarshrd@gmail.com**

**Subject:** Application – Business Development \& Marketing Executive

If you are a motivated fresher or early\-career professional looking to build a career in **business development, digital marketing and client management**, we would like to hear from you.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Business Development/ Tele\-calling/ Digital Marketing: 1 year (Preferred)

* Tamil (Required)

title: Social Media Marketeer
description:
**Job title** : Social Media Marketer

**Company:** Bytez Corp  
**Location:** Singanallur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu – 641005  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month (based on experience)  
**Experience:** Minimum 1 year preferred

**About Bytez Corp**

Bytez Corp is Tamil Nadu's premier full\-service branding agency, built on a simple promise — **"Your Growth is Our Responsibility."**

We work with businesses across different industries to build strong and memorable brands through creative branding, social media marketing, digital campaigns, and high\-quality visual content.

We are looking for a creative and energetic **Social Media Marketer** who can manage multiple client accounts, create engaging content, understand social media trends, and help brands grow their online presence.

**About the Role**

As a **Social Media Marketer**, you will be responsible for planning, creating, managing, and optimizing social media content for Bytez Corp and its client brands.

You will work closely with our **creative, design, video, and marketing teams** to develop content that increases brand awareness, engagement, followers, enquiries, and overall social media presence.

The ideal candidate should be **creative, trend\-aware, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple social media accounts simultaneously.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute social media strategies for multiple client brands.
* Manage daily social media activities across **Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms**.
* Create monthly and weekly **social media content calendars** based on client objectives.
* Research trending topics, hashtags, sounds, formats, and content ideas.
* Create engaging **Instagram Reels, Stories, Posts, Carousels, and short\-form videos**.
* Write creative captions, hooks, CTAs, and relevant hashtags.
* Coordinate with designers and video editors to develop high\-quality social media creatives.
* Create basic social media designs using **Canva** when required.
* Plan content around festivals, awareness days, events, promotions, and brand campaigns.
* Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and audience interactions.
* Improve engagement and build an active online community for client brands.
* Research competitors and identify new content opportunities.
* Analyse social media performance using platform insights and analytics.
* Track important metrics such as **reach, impressions, engagement rate, followers, views, saves, shares, and leads**.
* Prepare simple weekly/monthly social media performance reports.
* Identify underperforming content and suggest improvements.
* Stay updated with **Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube algorithm changes and emerging trends**.
* Work with the marketing team to align social media content with campaigns and business goals.
* Manage multiple client accounts and ensure content is published according to schedule.
* Maintain consistency in each client's **brand voice, visual identity, and communication style**.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of **Social Media Marketing**.
* Strong knowledge of **Instagram and Facebook**.
* Good understanding of Instagram Reels, Stories, Carousels, and short\-form content.
* Ability to identify and adapt to current social media trends.
* Good content planning and idea\-generation skills.
* Strong **caption writing and communication skills**.
* Basic knowledge of Canva and social media creative design.
* Understanding of hashtags, audience targeting, engagement, and content optimization.
* Basic knowledge of social media analytics and insights.
* Ability to manage multiple social media accounts and deadlines.
* Good communication skills in **English and Tamil**.
* Creative thinking with attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a team.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience handling social media accounts for multiple brands or clients.
* Experience in a digital marketing or branding agency.
* Basic knowledge of **Meta Business Suite**.
* Basic knowledge of Instagram and Facebook advertising.
* Experience creating or coordinating Reels and short\-form videos.
* Familiarity with tools such as **Canva, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, Google Trends, and social media analytics platforms**.
* Personal Instagram page, content portfolio, or previous social media work will be an added advantage.

**Who We're Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Thinks creatively and comes up with fresh content ideas.
* Understands what makes people stop scrolling.
* Keeps up with the latest social media trends.
* Can turn a simple business idea into engaging social media content.
* Is comfortable working with multiple brands and industries.
* Takes ownership of assigned accounts and deadlines.
* Is willing to learn new platforms, tools, and content formats.
* Has a strong interest in **Instagram, content creation, branding, and social media growth**.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on experience managing social media for multiple industries and brands.
* Opportunity to work on real\-world branding and content campaigns.
* Creative and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work closely with designers, video editors, and marketing strategists.
* Career growth toward **Senior Social Media Marketer / Social Media Manager / Content Strategist** roles.
* Opportunity to develop strong skills in social media strategy, content creation, and client management.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can send their **resume and social media portfolio/work samples** to:

**Email:** info.bytezcorp@gmail.com  
**Contact:** Mr. Senthilkumar – 78715 31777

**Note:** Candidates with previous social media work, Instagram pages, Reels, campaign samples, or content portfolios are encouraged to share their work along with their resume.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Electrical Industry - Marketing Executive
description:
**Job description:**

Location: Chennai(Local Candidates Preferred)

Experience: 3 – 7 Years \& Above (Electrical Industry Preferred)

Industry : Wires, Cables \& Electrical Products Sector

Reporting To : Senior Manager – Marketing

Salary: No Constraint for the Right Candidate

Job Type: Full\-Time \| Permanent

◆ ABOUT US

Kamadhenu Wires, an ISO 9001:2015 Company, is a leading manufacturer of wide variety of Wires \& Cables with a glorious track record of 33 years. Established in 1992 under the brand name POWER\-FLEX.

POWER – FLEX® wires and cables are manufactured at its state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility located in the industrial city of Coimbatore, India.

◆ ROLE OVERVIEW

This is a field\-based, relationship\-driven role. You will be the face of Power \- Flex in the market — visiting electrical companies, dealers, contractors, and industrial clients on a daily basis. Your primary mission is to build strong business relationships, generate leads, and grow our customer base within the electrical ecosystem.

◆ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Conduct daily field visits to electrical manufacturers, dealers, contractors, and industrial companies

· Identify and develop new business opportunities within the electrical and cable industry

· Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with key decision\-makers in the sector

· Present and promote POWER – FLEX® products effectively to prospective and existing clients

· Submit a detailed Day\-to\-Day Visit \& Communication Report to the Senior Executive

· Gather market intelligence on competitors, pricing, and industry trends

· Follow up on leads, negotiate deals, and close sales in a professional manner

· Represent the company at trade meetings, industry events, and exhibitions when required

· Maintain accurate records of client interactions and update CRM/reporting tools regularly

◆ WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

· 3–7 years of experience in B2B marketing or field sales *(electrical industry experience is a strong advantage)*

· Excellent communication skills — comfortable engaging with engineers, managers, and business owners in the electrical sector

· Self\-driven, highly honest, and ethical in all professional dealings

· Creative thinker who can find new ways to approach clients and grow market share

· Confident, friendly, and able to freely discuss technical and commercial topics with industry professionals

· Willing to travel extensively within the region for client visits

· Owns a two\-wheeler / has personal transport for field visits *(preferred)*

· Proficiency in local language; English communication skills

· Any Degree / Masters in Electrical, Marketing, Business Administration, or related field

◆ WHY JOIN POWERFLEX?

· Salary is NO constraint — we reward talent and performance generously

· Work directly with senior leadership and gain strategic exposure

· Stable, growing company with strong market reputation in India

· Open, supportive work culture where your ideas are heard and valued

· Opportunity to grow into a senior marketing or management role

· Be part of a passionate team driving excellence in the electrical industry

HOW TO APPLY

Send your updated resume to our HR Department

hr@powerflex.co.in\| \+91 9944893201

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Location:

* Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Required)

* 100% (Preferred)
